caseNameFull: Neblett v. Caminetti, Insurance Commissioner and Neblett v. Pacific Mutual Life Insurance Co.
attorneys: Mr. William Stanley for petitioners. Mr. Robert W. Kenny, Attorney General of California, for the Insurance Commissioner; and Messrs. T. B. Cosgrove, John N. Cramer, Allan P. Matthew, Eugene Overton, and Byron C. Hanna for the Pacific Mutual Life Insurance Co. et al., — respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Supreme Court of California denied. Mr. Justice Reed took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.

Reported below: 22 Cal. 2d 344, 393,139 P. 2d 908, 934.
